items.title: Did Improved Market Outlooks Just Shift CoStar's (CSGP) Investment Narrative?
items.summary: CoStar Group recently appointed Catrina Harding as Chief Human Resources Officer and published upgraded outlooks for Canadian retail rents and U.S. hotel performance, highlighting planned hiring in key U.S. cities, a focus on cost efficiency, and continued adoption of AI. Harding’s background in global expansion, acquisitions, and performance-based compensation, combined with CoStar Group’s more confident sector forecasts, points to tighter execution around talent, expenses, and product...
